# Brooklyn Paper

> > Hyperlocal news covering Brooklyn neighborhoods with detailed crime blotters, precinct reports, and community news.

Brooklyn Paper provides comprehensive coverage of Brooklyn's diverse neighborhoods including Fort Greene, Clinton Hill, Coney Island, Brighton Beach, and Bensonhurst. The publication is particularly known for its detailed NYPD precinct-by-precinct crime reporting, documenting robberies, assaults, thefts, and other incidents across the borough.

## Key Topics

- 88th Precinct (Fort Greene, Clinton Hill)
- 60th Precinct (Coney Island, Brighton Beach, Seagate)
- 62nd Precinct (Bensonhurst, Bath Beach)
- 76th Precinct (Carroll Gardens, Cobble Hill)
- 84th Precinct (Brooklyn Heights, DUMBO)
- Crime blotters and police reports
- Robbery and theft incidents
- Assault cases
- Burglary reports
- Bike theft
- Fort Greene neighborhood
- Coney Island community
- Bensonhurst area
- Brooklyn crime reporting
